title: Circ Out
description: Bắt đầu rất mạnh và dừng khá đột ngột, cho cảm giác cơ khí.out).

moworks.author: moworks

options.graph: a canvas to draw the curve on (a teaching guide; none by default)

moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 100 % on circ.out (√(1 − (1 − p)²); CSS approximation cubic-bezier(0,.55,.45,1)), 400 ms. Rule: strong start, abrupt stop, a mechanical feel. Small demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.4 s) · ease (circ.out).
